title: Road to live holds Publish for a new Joomla release whose content map lacks Slot fit, and only warns for a live one
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/content-coverage.test.mjs packages/web/tracy-harness/test/problem-guides.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A release not shown on Design inspiration whose content map has no Slot fit is todo coverage-fit with fitHolds true, and the publish refusal names Slot fit.
The same release shown on Design inspiration is warn coverage-live-fit.
A keep flag that disagrees with the measured kind is fitState invalid with its reason; slots without fit are counted and the first eight named.
The released JA Boxing 1.0.5 contract warns while live and holds otherwise.
The panel guide gives one prompt that measures Slot fit with the content coverage audit (--write --fit).

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/content-coverage/fit.js fitOfContentMap, fitOfRelease; apps/tracy-web/src/lib/content-coverage/judge.js judgeFit; apps/tracy-web/src/lib/content-coverage/road-step.js contentCoverageStep, contentCoverageRefusal; packages/web/tracy-harness/src/cms/problem-guides.ts guideOf

evidence: Every released content map predates Slot fit, and nothing on the Road to live held a new release whose map did not say the shape of its slots.
fence: contentCoverageStep judges the Slot fit group with judgeFit after holes and roles: todo coverage-fit for a release not shown, warn coverage-live-fit for a live one; contentCoverageRefusal names Slot fit.

tests: fit group: a content map without Slot fit holds a release not shown, naming Slot fit and the first keys
fit group: the same release shown on Design inspiration only warns
fit group: a keep flag that disagrees with the measured kind is invalid, with its reason
fit group: the released JA Boxing 1.0.5 contract has no Slot fit, so it warns while live and holds otherwise
Slot fit group of Content coverage: guides, lists and ONE prompt that measures Slot fit with the audit
